steps.text: Place the pilot rod end of the bearing installer assembly in the bearing. Support the spring housing, bearing and installer on a short sleeve on the bed of an arbor press as shown in Fig. 8. then press the bearing in the housing until the shoulder on the installer contacts the housing. NOTE: When the shoulder on the installer body contacts the housing, the bearing will be properly positioned in the housing.
